This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The Uploads section in docs/API.md mentions accepted date formats but omits details about accepted amount formats. This change adds a paragraph specifying accepted amount formats including decimal points, commas, signs, parentheses for negatives, and leading currency symbols as tested. This is a documentation-only update, no code changes or PR needed.
